models.fourfold: w_g=cos(4 theta_g) exactly from integer period vectors

contract.law: e_g=-(m-delta*w_g/2)*F1_g_prime; x_g=-(m+delta*w_g/2)*F2_g_prime; shifts constant in p near the pooled root
contract.calibration: fit only pooled moving-root rank1 response and pooled root response, separately per N; no angular coefficient or offset
contract.uncertainty: aligned delete-one original union batch for baseline, conditional source centering, matching root, calibration and all contrasts; full joint covariance
contract.interpretation: large residual relative to its paired SE invalidates the specified finite response law on this discovery block; it is not an independent significance certificate
contract.failure_rule: do not repair a failed angular law by fitting a new angular gain, changing lag, adding a descriptor or relabeling it a prospective test
